atomic_admission.scope: Exact fresh replay of accepted moves and recorded proper singleton alternatives. Untested proper subsets remain unknown; different singleton removals do not establish complementarity.

conditional_subsets.package_attribution: Only packet bytes are assigned to IDs. Dictionary and decoder are global, fully charged without subset discount; overlapping subset packages must not be summed.
